# National Theatre at Home

> > National Theatre at Home streams world-class theatre productions online, featuring plays from the National Theatre, Old Vic, and partner venues with full accessibility support.

The platform offers on-demand streaming of acclaimed theatrical productions including works by Arthur Miller, Noël Coward, and contemporary playwrights. Available across multiple devices including Samsung Smart TV, Fire TV, Apple TV, Roku, and mobile platforms, with comprehensive audio description options for accessibility.

## Key Topics

- National Theatre productions
- Audio description accessibility
- Theatre streaming
- Old Vic productions
- Full play recordings
- Arthur Miller plays
- Multi-platform streaming (Samsung Smart TV, Fire TV, Apple TV, Roku, Android TV, LG Smart TV)
- Political drama
- Contemporary theatre
- Classic theatre
- Video clips and previews
- Online theatre access
- Accessible theatre
- Theatre trailers

## Full Play Productions

- [All My Sons: Full Play](https://www.ntathome.com/all-my-sons/videos/all-my-sons-full-play): Full play of Arthur Miller's All My Sons starring Bill Pullman
- [A View from the Bridge: Full Play](https://www.ntathome.com/a-view-from-the-bridge/videos/a-view-from-the-bridge-full-play): Full play of Arthur Miller's A View from the Bridge with Mark Strong
- [Best of Enemies](https://www.ntathome.com/best-of-enemies): James Graham's Best of Enemies with David Harewood and Zachary Quinto
- [Chewing Gum Dreams: Full Play - Audio Description](https://www.ntathome.com/audio-description-chewing-gum-dreams/videos/audio-description-chewing-gum-dreams-full-play): Audio described full play of Michaela Coel's Chewing Gum Dreams
- [The Father and the Assassin: Full Play - Audio Description](https://www.ntathome.com/audio-description-the-father-and-the-assassin/videos/the-father-and-the-assassin-full-play-audio-description): Audio described full play of The Father and the Assassin with Hiran Abeysekera
- [The Other Place: Full Play - Audio Description](https://www.ntathome.com/audio-description-the-other-place/videos/the-other-place-full-play-audio-description): Audio described full play of The Other Place with Emma D'Arcy

## Audio Described Productions

- [Audio Description: Blues for an Alabama Sky](https://www.ntathome.com/audio-description-blues-for-an-alabama-sky): Audio described Pearl Cleage's Blues for an Alabama Sky with Samira Wiley
- [Audio Description: The Brightening Air](https://www.ntathome.com/audio-description-the-brightening-air): Audio described version of Conor McPherson's The Brightening Air (Old Vic)
- [Audio Description: I Want My Hat Back](https://www.ntathome.com/audio-description-i-want-my-hat-back): Audio described Jon Klassen's I Want My Hat Back children's show (ages 3+)
- [Audio Description: Medea](https://www.ntathome.com/audio-description-medea): Audio described Euripides' Medea with Helen McCrory (National Theatre Live)
- [Audio Description: Present Laughter](https://www.ntathome.com/audio-description-present-laughter): Audio described Noël Coward's Present Laughter with Andrew Scott (Old Vic)
